```tla
---- MODULE QuantumErrorCorrectionSystemSpec ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, TLC, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS 
    QUBITS,              \* Set of qubit identifiers
    STABILIZER_CODES,    \* Set of available stabilizer codes
    ERROR_TYPES,         \* Set of possible quantum errors {X, Y, Z, I}
    MAX_SYNDROME_WEIGHT, \* Maximum weight of syndrome measurements
    VERIFICATION_PROVERS \* Set of proof assistants {Agda, Coq, Lean4, Isabelle}

VARIABLES
    qubit_state,         \* Current quantum state vector
    syndrome_history,    \* History of syndrome measurements
    error_locations,     \* Detected error locations
    correction_operations, \* Applied correction operations
    verification_status, \* Status of formal verification
    cross_language_state, \* State shared across languages
    proof_obligations,   \* Current proof obligations to verify
    system_integrity,    \* Overall system integrity measure

          verification_status, cross_language_state, proof_obligations, system_integrity>>

\* Quantum state space definition
QuantumStateSpace == [qubit |-> [amplitude |-> REAL, phase |-> REAL] : qubit \in QUBITS]

\* Syndrome measurement space
SyndromeSpace == [stabilizer |-> {0, 1} : stabilizer \in STABILIZER_CODES]

\* Error correction invariants
ErrorCorrectionInvariant ==
    /\ \A q \in QUBITS : 
        /\ qubit_state[q].amplitude^2 + qubit_state[q].phase^2 <= 1
        /\ qubit_state[q].amplitude >= 0
    /\ Len(syndrome_history) <= MAX_SYNDROME_WEIGHT
    /\ \A syndrome \in Range(syndrome_history) :
        syndrome \in SyndromeSpace

\* Cross-language verification invariant
CrossLanguageInvariant ==
    /\ cross_language_state.futhark_gpu_state \in QuantumStateSpace
    /\ cross_language_state.chapel_parallel_state \in QuantumStateSpace
    /\ cross_language_state.zig_system_state \in QuantumStateSpace
    /\ cross_language_state.crystal_web_state \in QuantumStateSpace
    /\ cross_language_state.nim_native_state \in QuantumStateSpace
    /\ cross_language_state.haskell_pure_state \in QuantumStateSpace
    /\ \A lang1, lang2 \in DOMAIN cross_language_state :
        StateConsistency(cross_language_state[lang1], cross_language_state[lang2])

\* Formal verification invariant
FormalVerificationInvariant ==
    /\ verification_status.agda_proofs \subseteq proof_obligations
    /\ verification_status.coq_proofs \subseteq proof_obligations  
    /\ verification_status.lean4_proofs \subseteq proof_obligations
    /\ verification_status.isabelle_proofs \subseteq proof_obligations
    /\ \A prover \in VERIFICATION_PROVERS :
        verification_status[prover].status \in {"VERIFIED", "PENDING", "FAILED"}

\* Initial state specification
Init ==
    /\ qubit_state = [q \in QUBITS |-> [amplitude |-> 1.0, phase |-> 0.0]]
    /\ syndrome_history = <<>>
    /\ error_locations = {}
    /\ correction_operations = <<>>
    /\ verification_status = [prover \in VERIFICATION_PROVERS |-> 
        [status |-> "PENDING", proofs |-> {}, obligations |-> {}]]
    /\ cross_language_state = [
        futhark_gpu_state |-> qubit_state,
        chapel_parallel_state |-> qubit_state,
        zig_system_state |-> qubit_state,
        crystal_web_state |-> qubit_state,
        nim_native_state |-> qubit_state,
        haskell_pure_state |-> qubit_state,
        verilog_hw_state |-> qubit_state,
        llvm_ir_state |-> qubit_state

    /\ proof_obligations = {
        "QuantumUnitarity", "ErrorDetectionCorrectness", 
        "SyndromeExtractionSoundness", "StateCoherencePreservation",
        "CrossLanguageConsistency", "HardwareSoftwareEquivalence"

        /\ ApplyError(error_type, target_qubit)
        /\ UpdateSystemIntegrity(error_type)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<syndrome_history, error_locations, correction_operations, 
                   verification_status, proof_obligations>>

MeasureSyndrome ==
    /\ \E stabilizer \in STABILIZER_CODES :
        /\ LET syndrome == ExtractSyndrome(stabilizer, qubit_state)
           IN syndrome_history' = Append(syndrome_history, syndrome)
    /\ DetectErrorLocations(Head(syndrome_history'))
    /\ VerifyMeasurementCorrectness()
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qubit_state, correction_operations, verification_status>>

    /\ \E correction \in ComputeCorrections(error_locations) :
        /\ correction_operations' = Append(correction_operations, correction)
        /\ qubit_state' = ApplyCorrection(qubit_state, correction)
        /\ UpdateCrossLanguageState(qubit_state')
    /\ error_locations' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<syndrome_history, verification_status, proof_obligations>>

    /\ proof_obligations # {}
    /\ \E obligation \in proof_obligations, prover \in VERIFICATION_PROVERS :

        /\ LET proof_result == RunFormalVerification(prover, obligation)

                    ![prover].proofs = @ \union {proof_result.proof}]
              /\ IF proof_result.status = "VERIFIED"

                 ELSE proof_obligations' = proof_obligations
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qubit_state, syndrome_history, error_locations, 
                   correction_operations, cross_language_state>>

    /\ \E lang1, lang2 \in DOMAIN cross_language_state :
        /\ ~StateConsistency(cross_language_state[lang1], cross_language_state[lang2])
        /\ LET synchronized_state == ResolveStateInconsistency(
               cross_language_state[lang1], cross_language_state[lang2])

    /\ VerifyCrossLanguageConsistency()
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qubit_state, syndrome_history, error_locations,

          /\ ResetVerificationStatus()
          /\ RestoreSystemIntegrity()
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qubit_state, syndrome_history, error_locations>>

    qubit_state' = [qubit_state EXCEPT

    LET stabilizer_measurement == MeasureStabilizer(stabilizer, state)
    IN [stabilizer |-> stabilizer_measurement]

    /\ DOMAIN state1 = DOMAIN state2
    /\ \A qubit \in DOMAIN state1 :
        /\ Abs(state1[qubit].amplitude - state2[qubit].amplitude) < 0.001

    \/ MeasureSyndrome

    \/ VerifyHardwareSoftware
    \/ RecoverFromFailure

        StateConsistency(cross_language_state[lang1], cross_language_state[lang2]))

\* Temporal properties

    [](\A q \in QUBITS :

    [](system_integrity >= 0.95)

    <>[](verification_status \in [prover \in VERIFICATION_PROVERS |->
```

```vale
  var old_qubit := qs.qubits[qubit_index];
  var old_amp := old_qubit.amplitude.Amp;
  var old_phase := old_qubit.phase.Phase;

  var new_phase := inv_sqrt2 * (old_amp - old_phase);

    Amp(new_amp),
    Phase(new_phase),
    old_qubit.entangled_with,
    old_qubit.measurement_basis
  );
  
  qs' := qs.(qubits := qs.qubits[qubit_index := new_qubit]);
  
  // Update memory with quantum state

  // Verify unitarity preservation
  assert quantum_norm_preserved(qs, qs');
}
```
